_comment: Regression suite for review-ticket.py. 01-09 are hand-written tickets, one per scenario in the validation set. 10-12 are bodies exactly as GitHub renders a submission from an issue form (.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.yml), which is the path a human actually takes and the one that broke first: a form renders each field's label verbatim as a heading, and those labels are not the canonical section names. Any new or renamed form field needs a fixture here and a row in the checker's SECTION_ALIASES. Run with scripts/run-fixtures.sh. These double as the worked examples create-ticket/examples.md cites, so an edit here is an edit to reference material. All content is synthetic.

02-well-defined.title: Add idle expiration to admin sessions

03-bug.title: Fix customer list overflow on mobile

04-security.title: Rate limit the password reset endpoint

05-infra.title: Enable Object Lock on the log archive bucket
05-infra.scenario: infrastructure change with an unsatisfied prerequisite

06-tech-debt.title: Consolidate invoice date handling into one utility

07-spike.title: Decide whether to replace the message queue

08-blocked.title: Notify users when an invoice becomes overdue
08-blocked.scenario: unresolved dependency and an open decision. Mechanically clean, and BLOCKED on judgement: the delivery channel is undecided and #999 does not resolve. This is the division of labour working, not the script failing

09-human-approval.title: Add retention-based deletion to the events table

10-form-task.title: Add idle expiration to admin sessions
10-form-task.scenario: task.yml submission. Proves the form's labels normalise and that a High risk reason is read from its own field rather than from the dropdown

11-form-bug.title: Fix customer list overflow on mobile
11-form-bug.scenario: bug.yml submission. Proves British spelling and 'Risk of the fix' resolve, and that a blank optional field rendered as _No response_ counts as absent, not empty

12-form-spike.title: Decide whether to replace the message queue
12-form-spike.scenario: spike.yml submission. Proves a spike is not required to carry acceptance criteria
